convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for ColorJ2JMAStDev indicator and includes TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for trading logic (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory, CIsNewBar). Custom indicator with 6 buffers and complex signal modes require manual mapping.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds
derived_values.used_by: New bar detection and history loading

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator calculation

other_exits: POINT mode buy close: buffer 2 or buffer 4 not empty (sell signals act as buy close)
DIRECT mode buy close: line[SignalBar] > line[SignalBar+1] (line turning down)
POINT mode sell close: buffer 3 or buffer 5 not empty (buy signals act as sell close)
DIRECT mode sell close: line[SignalBar] < line[SignalBar+1] (line turning up)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum selects sizing method: LOT=fixed lots, FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss. MM parameter (0.1) is the fraction or lot size depending on mode.

custom_logic_notes: Three signal modes (POINT/DIRECT/WITHOUT) independently configurable for buy open, sell open, buy close, sell close. POINT mode uses colored dot/cloud buffers (2-5) detecting non-EMPTY_VALUE signals. DIRECT mode uses line buffer (0) detecting turning points. WITHOUT disables that signal path. SignalBar input (default=1) shifts which bar is read; if SignalBar==0, signals are evaluated every tick instead of only on new bars. Recount flag triggers re-evaluation on next tick if CopyBuffer fails. CIsNewBar class from TradeAlgorithms.mqh controls new bar detection. LoadHistory pre-loads bar history. GlobalVariableDel_ cleans up global variables on deinit.
python_conversion_notes: Requires reimplementation of ColorJ2JMAStDev custom indicator (J2JMA double smoothing + standard deviation channels with dK1/dK2 multipliers producing 6 buffers). TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, CIsNewBar, LoadHistory, GlobalVariableDel_) must be reimplemented. The MarginMode enum with 5 sizing modes needs careful mapping. Signal logic is mode-dependent (POINT vs DIRECT vs WITHOUT) and reads from 6 indicator buffers with different semantics per buffer. Entry uses SignalBar offset (default bar[1]) meaning signals are confirmed on closed bars.
